review_basis: Reviewed the complete locally installed Plugin Creator validator and its identifier-validation import before validating the Design DNA candidate.
trust_boundary: Publisher-reviewed pins cover the validator and declared sibling import, while the attestation separately binds the current Python executable and pure-Python PyYAML snapshot. It does not bind jsonschema, every Python standard-library or runtime file, or provide an operating-system filesystem sandbox. It is not an OpenAI signature or proof that a future revision is equivalent.
